title: The suite runs the validate gate and fails the pipeline on any non-zero exit
asA: reviewer opening a pull request against the default branch
iWant: the pipeline to have already run `rcf define validate` against the head commit's tree and refused the run on any schema or reference issue
soThat: I never review a change whose chain is structurally broken

acceptanceCriteria.description: The suite invokes `rcf define validate` before any other gate. The gate's exit code, captured stdout, and captured stderr are written to a per-gate report at the configured stable path. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the elicited report directory; the AC substitutes the project's path for the illustrative default.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pipeline has run against the head commit
acceptanceCriteria.when: the reviewer opens the per-gate report file at `<reportDir>/validate.json`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the file exists, its `gate` field is `validate`, its `command` field names the `rcf define validate` invocation, its `exitCode` field records the underlying process exit code, and its `stdout` and `stderr` fields carry the captured streams

acceptanceCriteria.description: A non-zero exit from `rcf define validate` marks the aggregate verdict as failed and the aggregate exit code as non-zero. The pipeline does not proceed to declare the run passed on the basis of downstream gates alone.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an invocation of the suite against a tree that fails `rcf define validate` (a deliberately broken reference)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the aggregate report's `verdict` field is `failed`, its `gates[]` entry for `validate` records `outcome: failed`, and the Node entry point's process exit code is non-zero

acceptanceCriteria.description: The validate gate exit code carries through to the pipeline: a validate command that returns exit 5 marks the gate failed with a per-gate report that records the exit code and the failing command; the aggregate refuses pipeline pass.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a validate gate configured to run a stub that exits 5
acceptanceCriteria.then: the per-gate report writes verdict=failed with exitCode=5 and the command name; the aggregate refuses pipeline pass
